subproblem.title: A linear functional on test forms bounded by B·sup|ω| is a current of mass at most B (supplied fact (F5/F6))
subproblem.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P (ℝ^P = Eucl P) be any set, D^n(U) := TestFormOn U n and |γ| := covectorEuclideanNorm γ. Let T₀ : D^n(U) → ℝ be a function and B ∈ ℝ such that T₀(ω + η) = T₀(ω) + T₀(η) and T₀(c·ω) = c·T₀(ω) for all ω, η ∈ D^n(U) and c ∈ ℝ, and |T₀(ω)| ≤ B·C for every ω ∈ D^n(U) and every C ∈ ℝ with |ω(y)| ≤ C for all y ∈ ℝ^P. Then there is S ∈ GeometricCurrentOn U n with S(ω) = T₀(ω) for every ω ∈ D^n(U) and S.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T₀ : TestFormOn U n → ℝ) (B : ℝ), (∀ ω η : TestFormOn U n, T₀ (ω + η) = T₀ ω + T₀ η) → (∀ (c : ℝ) (ω : TestFormOn U n), T₀ (c • ω) = c * T₀ ω) → (∀ (ω : TestFormOn U n) (C : ℝ), (∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) y) ≤ C) → |T₀ ω| ≤ B * C) → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ ω, S ω = T₀ ω) ∧ S.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: fact (F5/F6) (current criterion) of the supplied proof of lipschitz_pushforward. The sequential continuity is obtained from the reused accepted lemma continuity_criterion (fiw_ims_sc_continuous_of_bound), which replaces the operator-norm comparison used in (F5/F6).

1. (Sequential continuity.) Let K ⊆ U be compact and put A := B. If ω ∈ D^n(U) and C > 0 satisfy tsupport ω ⊆ K and |ω(x)| ≤ C for all x, then |T₀(ω)| ≤ B·C = A·C by the hypothesis (the support condition and C > 0 are not even needed). So the hypothesis of continuity_criterion holds for L := T₀, and it gives: for every sequence (ω_q) in D^n(U) with TestFormOnConverges ω_q 0, T₀(ω_q) → 0.
2. (The current.) By the additivity and homogeneity hypotheses (c·T₀(ω) is c • T₀(ω) in ℝ), T₀ is an ℝ-linear map D^n(U) → ℝ. Together with step 1 (the field continuous' of GeometricCurrentOn) it defines S ∈ GeometricCurrentOn U n with toCurrent := T₀, so S(ω) = T₀(ω) for every ω by definition.
3. (Mass.) By definition S.mass = S.massOn U = sSup {ENNReal.ofReal(S(ω)) : ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn U n U}. If ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn U n U, then |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for every x, so the hypothesis with C := 1 gives S(ω) = T₀(ω) ≤ |T₀(ω)| ≤ B·1 = B, hence ENNReal.ofReal(S(ω)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B (ENNReal.ofReal is monotone). Therefore the supremum is at most ENNReal.ofReal B (sSup_le), i.e. S.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B. ∎
proof_key_steps: The bound |T₀ ω| ≤ B·C gives the local hypothesis of continuity_criterion with A := B, so T₀ is sequentially continuous at 0.
Additivity and homogeneity make T₀ a linear map; with the continuity it is a GeometricCurrentOn U n with S = T₀.
For mass-admissible ω (|ω| ≤ 1), S(ω) ≤ |T₀ ω| ≤ B, so the mass supremum is ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B.

audit.reason: The proof constructs the linear map and required sequential-continuity field, then bounds the defining mass supremum using C=1. It proves the exact contract for arbitrary U and B; no separate nonnegativity assumption is missing.
